title: Calculating the Northgate Optical Switch-Down Credit
content:
The switch-down credit on a Northgate Optical eyewear job is calculated from the job's charge and credit ledger and from the base lens price of the lens design the job now carries.

## The amounts

**Switch-down price gap.** The switch-down price gap is the original base-lens charge, less every credit already posted against it, minus the base lens price of the lens design the job now carries, and never less than zero. The original base-lens charge is the base-lens charge of the original order (remake number 0); the base lens price is the figure for the lens design on the job today, read from the lens design price schedule.

**Switch-down credit.** The switch-down credit is half of the switch-down price gap, less a switch-down refit fee of 15.00, never less than zero, rounded to the cent.

## Order of working

The switch-down credit is worked out in this order: the credited part of the switch-down price gap is first raised by the switch-down courtesy uplift percentage, the switch-down spend bonus is then added and the switch-down refit fee deducted, and the result is floored at zero and rounded to the cent once.

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Credited part of the switch-down price gap | half of the gap (50 percent) |
| Switch-down courtesy uplift percentage | 0 percent |
| Switch-down spend bonus | 0.00 |
| Switch-down refit fee | 15.00 |
| Floor and rounding | floored at zero, rounded to the cent once, at the end |

## Worked figures (hypothetical jobs)

| Original base-lens charge | Credits already against it | Lens design now on the job (base lens price) | Gap | Half of the gap | Less refit fee 15.00 | Switch-down credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 199.99 | none | Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses (149.99) | 50.00 | 25.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| 169.99 | none | Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses (99.99) | 70.00 | 35.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 |
| 99.99 | none | Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses (89.99) | 10.00 | 5.00 | below zero | 0.00 |
| 149.99 | vision plan allowance 54.99 | Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses (99.99) | 0.00 (95.00 is below 99.99) | 0.00 | below zero | 0.00 |

In the last row the credits already posted bring the original charge below the new design's price, so there is no gap to credit.
